start.title: Your skills, in files you own
start.lead: Build a picture of your skills from what you've done, see what a pathway asks for, and decide what to learn next.
start.storage: Your profile is a folder of Markdown files on your computer. Pharoam reads and writes them in your browser, never on Pharoam's servers, and you can open them in any editor.
start.chooseHint: Choose the folder your profile is in, or an empty one to start a new profile. The browser will ask you to let Pharoam use it.

denied.title: Pharoam needs permission to read and write the folder
denied.text: Your profile is the files in that folder, so Pharoam can't open or create it without your permission. Nothing was written. Choose the folder again and allow access when the browser asks.

forgotten.title: The browser no longer has your folder
forgotten.text: Choose it again to carry on where you left off.

unavailable.title: Pharoam couldn't read {{folder}}
unavailable.text: The browser may have lost access to it, or it may have moved. Nothing was written. Choose the folder again.

browser.storage: This browser can't open a folder on your computer, so Pharoam keeps your profile in the browser's own storage on this device, as the same Markdown files. It never leaves your device, and you can download a copy whenever you like.
browser.choose: Keep my profile in this browser
browser.bringInHint: Bring in a copy you downloaded and unzipped, or any profile folder. Pharoam copies its files into this browser and leaves the folder as it is.

notEmpty.title: There's already a profile in this browser
notEmpty.text: Open it instead. Pharoam never writes over it.

unavailable.title: This browser won't keep files for Pharoam
unavailable.text: Private windows don't keep a website's files. Open Pharoam in a normal window to keep your profile.

createProfile.title: Create your profile in {{folder}}
createProfile.lead: There's no profile in this folder yet. Pharoam will add pharoam.md and the folders skills, evidence and gaps. Files already in the folder are left as they are.
createProfile.optional: Everything here is optional, and you can change it later. Pharoam never asks for your name, photo or contact details.
createProfile.headline: Headline
createProfile.headlineHint: A line about you, in your own words, such as "Backend developer moving into ML".
createProfile.failed: Pharoam couldn't create your profile. Nothing was overwritten. {{reason}}
createProfile.leadBrowser: There's no profile in this browser yet. Pharoam will keep pharoam.md and the folders skills, evidence and gaps in its storage on this device.

unreadableProfile.title: pharoam.md in {{folder}} can't be read
unreadableProfile.text: The folder has a profile file, but it isn't in a form Pharoam can read, so Pharoam won't replace it. Open pharoam.md in an editor to fix it, or choose another folder.

profileHome.lead: From your folder {{folder}}. The files there are the master copy.
profileHome.attention_one: {{count}} file needs your attention and is left out until it's fixed.
profileHome.attention_other: {{count}} files need your attention and are left out until they're fixed.
profileHome.leadBrowser: Kept in this browser's storage on this device. Download a copy to keep it somewhere safe.

shell.closeLabel: Close the profile in this browser
shell.footer: Pharoam · open source · your files stay in your folder
shell.footerBrowser: Pharoam · open source · your files stay in this browser

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: How Pharoam works for you. These settings last until you close the profile or reload the page.

model.title: A model for AI help
model.none: No model is set up. Everything in Pharoam works without one; AI help, when it arrives, asks you to set one up first.

providers.local: A local server, such as Ollama or LM Studio

model.keyHint: Kept only in this page's memory. It is never saved, and reloading the page or closing the profile forgets it.
model.addressHint: The server's OpenAI-compatible address on this computer, such as http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama or http://localhost:1234/v1 for LM Studio.
model.terms: What you send goes to {{provider}}, under its own terms, not Pharoam's. Pharoam never sees it.
model.localTerms: What you send stays on this machine.
model.localSteps: A local server needs two things first. Allow this app's address, {{origin}}, in the server: set OLLAMA_ORIGINS for Ollama, or turn on Enable CORS in LM Studio. Then allow local network access when your browser asks. Safari doesn't let web pages reach a local server, so local models don't work there.
model.typeIdHint: As the provider names it, such as one from its documentation.
model.noModel: Choose a model from the list, or type its ID.
model.works: It works: the model answered in the shape Pharoam needs.
model.notLocal: Pharoam can only reach a local server on this machine, at an address starting http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1.

errors.unauthorised: {{provider}} refused the key. Check it and try again.
errors.rateLimited: {{provider}} asked for a pause. Try again in a minute.
errors.unreachable: Pharoam couldn't reach {{provider}}. Check your connection; for a local server, check the two steps above.
errors.invalidAnswer: The model answered, but not in the shape Pharoam needs. Try a model that can call tools.

unsupported.title: This browser isn't supported yet
unsupported.lead: Pharoam keeps your profile in a folder on your computer or in the browser's own storage, and this browser can do neither.
unsupported.browsers: Use a recent version of Safari, Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave or Arc on a desktop or laptop. If you're in a private window, open a normal one.

notFound.title: There's nothing at this address
notFound.lead: The link may be old, or mistyped.

overview.title: Overview
overview.note: Pharoam keeps this section up to date from your evidence and skills. Your own words outside it are never changed.

gapSummary.title: Your gap to {{pathway}}
gapSummary.note: What the pathway asks for, beside what your profile shows. There is no score or total.

group.below: Below the level asked, for now

source.ai-judged: an AI judgement from your evidence

about.title: About you
about.lead: How you describe yourself in pharoam.md. Your own words below its top block are yours: Pharoam never changes them.
about.failed: Pharoam couldn't save your changes. Nothing was overwritten. Try again, or check the folder is still there.

changedOutside.title: pharoam.md was changed in your folder since Pharoam read it
changedOutside.text: Nothing has been overwritten. Compare the two versions and choose which to keep.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: pharoam.md has a short overview of your evidence and skills, between two markers, so the file makes sense without Pharoam. It's updated whenever your evidence or skills change.
overview.refresh: Bring the overview up to date
overview.done: The overview in pharoam.md is up to date.
overview.failed: Pharoam couldn't update the overview. Nothing was overwritten.

markers.title: The overview in pharoam.md can't be updated
markers.text: Its markers have been changed, and Pharoam won't guess where your words end. Open pharoam.md in an editor and leave one start marker followed by one end marker, or remove both, then try again.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.lead_zero: Records of things you did. Evidence is linked to skills; it carries no level.
evidence.lead_one: {{count}} record of something you did. Evidence is linked to skills; it carries no level.
evidence.lead_other: {{count}} records of things you did. Evidence is linked to skills; it carries no level.
evidence.empty: No evidence yet. Start with something you did recently: a project, a job, or a course you finished.
evidence.keptFiles: These files were kept, as they changed in your folder since they were shown or couldn't be deleted: {{files}}.
evidence.pasted_one: {{count}} record was saved from your pasted text.
evidence.pasted_other: {{count}} records were saved from your pasted text.
evidence.kindQuestion: What kind of evidence is it?

hints.title: What it was, such as a project's name or a job title.
hints.dateOne: For something that happened at one time. A year, month or day: 2024, 2024-09 or 2024-09-30.
hints.date: A year, month or day: 2024, 2024-09 or 2024-09-30.
hints.links: One web address per line, starting with https://.
hints.description: In your own words. You can use Markdown.

errors.title: Give it a title, such as the project's name or your job title.
errors.date: Write a date as a year, a month or a day, such as 2024, 2024-09 or 2024-09-30.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end is before the start.
errors.links: Each link must start with http:// or https://, such as https://example.com.
errors.credits: Write credits as a number, such as 15.
errors.unknownSkill: There's no skill called {{skill}}. Pick one from the list.

preview.title: Check before saving
preview.lead: This is the file Pharoam will add to your folder, exactly as it will be stored. Nothing is written until you save.
preview.file: The file as it will be stored

evidence.saveFailed: Pharoam couldn't save the evidence. Nothing was overwritten. Try again, or check the folder is still there.
evidence.newLead: Something you did: a project, a job, a course or a certificate. You can link it to skills.
evidence.editLead: Pharoam rewrites the file with your changes and keeps everything else in it.

changedOutside.title: This file was changed in your folder since Pharoam read it
changedOutside.text: Nothing has been overwritten. Compare the two versions and choose which to keep.

page.notEditable: Pharoam's form doesn't edit this kind of evidence. You can change it in your folder.
page.missing: There's no evidence at this address. It may have been deleted.

delete.title: Delete {{title}}?
delete.cited_one: Your level for {{skills}} cites it. That level stays, and will show this evidence as removed.
delete.cited_other: Your levels for {{skills}} cite it. Those levels stay, and will show this evidence as removed.
delete.alsoFiles: Also delete its files from your folder
delete.filesUnknown: Pharoam couldn't list its files, so any it has will be kept.
delete.failed: Pharoam couldn't delete the evidence. Nothing was changed.

files.title: Files
files.empty: No files yet. You can keep a certificate, a transcript or your original CV with this evidence.
files.attachHint: Any type, up to 10 MB. It's kept in your folder next to this evidence, and never opened inside Pharoam.
files.tooLarge: {{name}} is over 10 MB, so it wasn't attached.
files.attachFailed: Pharoam couldn't keep {{name}} in your folder. It may be full, or no longer available. Nothing was changed.
files.readFailed: Pharoam couldn't read {{name}} from your folder.
files.changed: {{name}} changed in your folder since it was shown, so it wasn't deleted.
files.removeFailed: Pharoam couldn't remove {{name}}. Nothing was changed.
files.notUnlisted: {{name}} was deleted from your folder, but this evidence still lists it.
files.listFailed: Pharoam couldn't list this evidence's files.

paste.title: Paste text
paste.lead: Paste your CV or a list of modules, and the model you set up turns it into evidence records for you to check. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
paste.noModel: Reading pasted text needs a model of your choice.
paste.setUp: Set up a model in Settings
paste.textHint: Up to {{max}} characters. Only this text is sent, to the model you set up.
paste.tooLong: That's more than {{max}} characters. Paste a part at a time.
paste.loadFailed: Pharoam couldn't load what it needs to reach {{provider}}. Check your connection and try again.
paste.failed: Nothing was saved. Your text is still here.

send.title: What will be sent
send.lead: Check what goes to {{provider}} before it is sent. It goes under {{provider}}'s own terms, not Pharoam's.
send.size: {{size}} characters in all, with Pharoam's instructions to the model.

review.title: Check what was found
review.lead_one: {{count}} record was found in your text. Edit it, or leave it out, then save.
review.lead_other: {{count}} records were found in your text. Edit any of them, leave out what you don't want, then save.
review.none: The model found no evidence in your text. Nothing was saved.
review.label: AI-normalised
review.mistakes: AI can make mistakes. Check each record before you save it.
review.similar: This looks like {{title}}, which you already have. It's left out unless you include it.
review.twin: This looks like {{title}}, found above. It's left out unless you include it.
review.needsFix: This record needs a fix before it can be saved.
review.editFirst: Finish or cancel your edit first.
review.keep: Keep a copy of the pasted text with each record
review.keepHint: Saved as original-input.txt next to each record, so you can always see where it came from.
review.saveFailed_one: Pharoam couldn't save {{title}}. {{count}} record was saved before it; the rest are still here.
review.saveFailed_other: Pharoam couldn't save {{title}}. {{count}} records were saved before it; the rest are still here.

paste.disclaimer: AI-generated from your pasted text and confirmed by you. AI can make mistakes.

scan.linksLead: The model you set up reads each piece of evidence you pick and suggests the skills it shows. Nothing is linked until you accept a suggestion in Review.
scan.levelsLead: The model you set up judges each skill you pick from the evidence linked to it, and nothing else. Nothing is recorded until you accept a suggestion in Review.
scan.noModel: Suggesting skills and levels needs a model of your choice.
scan.setUp: Set up a model in Settings
scan.noEvidence: There's no evidence to read yet.
scan.noSkills: No skill has linked evidence yet. Link skills to your evidence first, by hand or with Suggest skills.

send.title: What will be sent
send.lead: Check what goes to {{provider}} before it is sent. It goes under {{provider}}'s own terms, not Pharoam's.
send.linkCalls_one: {{count}} call, one for each piece of evidence, each with that record only.
send.linkCalls_other: {{count}} calls, one for each piece of evidence, each with that record only.
send.levelCalls_one: {{count}} call, one for each skill, with its linked evidence only.
send.levelCalls_other: {{count}} calls, one for each skill, with its linked evidence only.
send.size: {{size}} characters in all, with Pharoam's instructions to the model.

scan.leaving: Leaving this page stops the scan, keeping what finished.
scan.stopped: The scan was stopped. What finished is kept.
scan.already_one: {{count}} would change nothing, so it isn't offered.
scan.already_other: {{count}} would change nothing, so they aren't offered.
scan.failed: Pharoam couldn't save the scan's suggestions. {{reason}}
scan.loadFailed: Pharoam couldn't load what it needs to reach {{provider}}. Check your connection and try again.
scan.broke: The scan stopped because something went wrong. What finished is kept in Review.

reasons.rate-limited: the provider had too many calls for now
reasons.invalid-answer: the answer wasn't in the shape asked for

review.title: Review
review.lead: What AI suggested from your evidence, waiting for your decision. Nothing here counts until you accept it.
review.mistakes: AI can make mistakes. Check each suggestion before you accept it.
review.label: AI-suggested
review.stale: Its evidence changed since the scan read it. Scan it again to get a fresh suggestion.
review.adjusted: Your own level was recorded instead.
review.refused_one: {{count}} couldn't be accepted: its evidence changed since the scan read it.
review.refused_other: {{count}} couldn't be accepted: their evidence changed since the scan read it.
review.replaced: A newer scan judged this skill again. Decide its suggestion instead.
review.replacedRefused_one: {{count}} couldn't be accepted: a newer scan judged its skill again.
review.replacedRefused_other: {{count}} couldn't be accepted: newer scans judged their skills again.
review.failed: Pharoam couldn't save a decision. The rest is still here.
review.skippedNote: They stay here, pending, and never count.
review.deleteQuestion: Delete this scan's record? Any suggestion still pending in it is dropped; what you accepted stays.
review.deleteFailed: Pharoam couldn't delete the scan's record. Nothing was changed.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.lead: Every AI call made with this profile in this session, newest first: what was sent, to which model, and what came back.
activity.memory: It's kept in memory only. Closing the profile or reloading the page clears it, and nothing here is written to your storage.
activity.none: No AI calls yet in this session.

outcomes.inReview: Answered: its suggestions are decided in Review

activity.details: What was sent and what came back

skills.title: Skills
skills.lead_zero: Every level says where it came from.
skills.lead_one: {{count}} skill. Every level says where it came from.
skills.lead_other: {{count}} skills. Every level says where it came from.
skills.empty: No skills yet. Record a level for something you can do, or add a skill the list is missing.
skills.noMatch: No skills match. Try another search or domain.
skills.whichLevel: One level each: your latest diagnostic, otherwise your newest claim, your own or an AI judgement you accepted

detail.noLinked: No evidence is linked to this skill yet.

recordPage.title: Record a level
recordPage.lead: Your own rating of a skill. It's added to the skill's history; nothing already there changes.
recordPage.own: This is your own rating. Citing evidence doesn't test it.
recordPage.skillHint: Start typing a skill's name. If it isn't in the list, add your own skill first.
recordPage.noEvidence: You have no evidence to cite yet.

errors.skill: Pick a skill from the list, or add your own skill first.

recordPage.failed: Pharoam couldn't record the level. Nothing was overwritten.

skillPage.missing: There's nothing in your profile for this skill.
skillPage.noRecord: You haven't recorded a level for this skill yet.
skillPage.noCount: No level counts for this skill now.
skillPage.historyLead: Every level this skill has had, newest first. Nothing is ever deleted: corrections and retractions are added.
skillPage.correctLead: Your new level is added and replaces this one. This one stays in the history, marked as corrected.
skillPage.retractLead: It stops counting, and stays in the history, marked as retracted.
skillPage.failed: Pharoam couldn't save that. Nothing was overwritten.
skillPage.changedOutside: This skill's file was changed in your folder since Pharoam read it. Nothing has been overwritten.
skillPage.outOfDate: The evidence behind your AI level has changed since it was judged. Pharoam never judges it again on its own.

customPage.title: Add your own skill
customPage.lead: For something you can do that the skill list doesn't have. It's marked as your own wherever it appears, and never counts for a pathway's requirements.
customPage.name: Name
customPage.exists: You already have a skill called {{name}}.
customPage.failed: Pharoam couldn't add the skill. Nothing was overwritten.

pathways.title: Pathways
pathways.lead: What different roles ask for. Open one to see what it asks for, and your gap to it.
pathways.aiDrafted: Drafted with AI ({{model}}), then reviewed by {{by}}. AI can be wrong: every requirement lists its sources.
pathways.missing: There's no pathway at this address.
pathways.seeGap: See my gap to this pathway

gap.title: Your gap to {{pathway}}
gap.lead: What the pathway asks for, beside what your profile shows. Every pathway can be explored, however far off it is.
gap.refresh: Bring the gap up to date

meaning.title: What this gap might mean
meaning.lead: With a model set up, AI can read this gap and the titles of the evidence your levels cite, and suggest what it might mean for you and places you could start. Nothing is saved unless you accept it.
meaning.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. This is something to think with, not advice, and it never changes a level.
meaning.noteDisclaimer: AI-generated explanation of a gap, accepted by you. AI can make mistakes; it changes no level.
meaning.noModel: To ask, set up a model first.

send.title: What will be sent
send.lead: {{pathway}}, its requirements and Pharoam's instructions, and this from your profile. It goes to {{provider}} under its own terms, not Pharoam's.
send.part: Where you stand, with the titles of the evidence your levels cite

meaning.ready: The explanation is ready. Nothing is saved yet.
meaning.unsaved: By {{model}}. Not saved: accept it to keep it as a note, as it is or edited.
meaning.editLabel: The explanation, as it will be saved
meaning.editHint: In Markdown. It is saved as you leave it.
meaning.empty: The explanation is empty. Write something, or discard it.
meaning.saveFailed: The note couldn't be saved, so nothing was written. Try again.
meaning.outOfDate: Your profile has changed since this explanation. Ask again for one of your gap as it is now.

groups.claimed: Your word, or an AI judgement you accepted
groups.below: Under the level asked, for now

groupLeads.supported: At or above the level asked. Only a tested level supports a requirement.
groupLeads.claimed: At or above the level asked, by your word or an AI judgement. It hasn't been tested.
groupLeads.below: The clearest places to learn next.
groupLeads.unknown: Not a gap until you know. You may already have these.

gap.changedOutside: The stored gap was changed in your folder since Pharoam read it. Nothing has been overwritten.
gap.failed: Pharoam couldn't save the gap in your folder. Nothing was overwritten.
gap.problem: The stored gap couldn't be brought up to date after your last change. Bring it up to date to try again.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.lead: Files Pharoam can't use as they are, and files changed in your folder while Pharoam was saving them.
attention.brokenLead: Each one is left out until it's fixed, and Pharoam never changes or deletes it. Open it in an editor to fix it.
attention.conflictsLead: These files were changed in your folder since Pharoam read them. Nothing has been overwritten. Choose which version to keep.
attention.mineDelete: Pharoam was about to delete this file.
attention.theirsUnreadable: Pharoam can't read the version in your folder, so it can only keep it. Fix it in an editor if it needs fixing.
attention.theirsGone: The file is no longer in your folder.
attention.keepTheirs: Keep the version in your folder
attention.resolveFailed: Pharoam couldn't keep that version. Nothing was overwritten.

problems.no-top-block: It has no top block: the file should start with a line of three dashes (---), then its fields.
problems.unclosed-top-block: Its top block isn't closed: add a line of three dashes (---) after the fields.
problems.invalid-yaml: Its top block isn't valid YAML: {{message}} (line {{line}}).
problems.not-fields: Its top block doesn't hold fields.
problems.too-many-aliases: Its top block uses too many YAML aliases to read safely.
problems.not-utf8: It isn't UTF-8 text, so Pharoam can't read it without changing it.
problems.unknown-schema: Its schema isn't one Pharoam knows.
problems.unsupported-version: It's written for a newer version of Pharoam.
problems.duplicate-id: Another file has the same ID: {{file}}. Give one of them a new ID.
problems.unavailable: Pharoam couldn't read it from your folder.

copy.title: Keep a copy somewhere safe
copy.text: Your profile is only in this browser. Some browsers, Safari among them, can delete a website's files after 7 days without a visit, unless you add Pharoam to the Dock (File > Add to Dock). Download a copy now and then, and keep it with your other files.
copy.persisted: This browser has agreed to keep your profile, but a copy somewhere else is still wise.
copy.failed: Pharoam couldn't make the copy. Nothing was changed.
